notes: All 118 record values checked against Tables 1-3: no mismatches. Omni TM-AE embedding length equals the vocabulary size d (Sec. 3.4), i.e. 40,000 for One Billion Word and 20,000 for IMDb; baselines use dim 100. Clause count 32 is the CoTM clause pool c (state_matrix c x l, weight_matrix c x m); the paper also says the embedding of a word comes from 'training TM-AE for the target word', so whether each target word gets its own 32-clause machine (then per_output) is not fully clear; kept 'total' per Sec. 3.3. n_states 128 is printed only for the Fig. 3 experiment (1,600-word vocabulary) and matches 8 state bits. Hyper-parameters were tuned with the t-SNE visualisation (Sec. 4.4), not a validation set; selection_on_test left not_reported. KMeans number of clusters, how documents are embedded for clustering/classification, and the IMDb split are not stated. Table 3 label counts are kept as printed (Yelp 11,537; AG News 5). Record category 'generative_sequence' fits poorly: the paper is representation learning.
